Discover the Versatility of Ductless Mini-Splits

Like conventional air conditioners and heat pumps, ductless systems are powered by an outdoor unit containing a compressor and condenser. Instead of a central air handler, however, mini-splits feature one or more individual air handling units that produce direct, targeted heating and cooling. A small conduit connects each air handler to the outdoor unit, supplies power and refrigerant, and carries away condensation.

This clever and compact design makes it easy to deliver conditioned air exactly where it's needed. Since there's no ductwork, there are no air leaks to waste energy and cost you money. Mini-split systems are also easy to modify or expand if you need to make changes in the future.

Ductless Systems Designed to Serve Your Needs

A great HVAC system starts with high-quality equipment, and ductless mini-splits are no exception. At G.C. Reliable Service, we've got premium single- and multi-zone models from top names like Lennox and Daikin. Mini-split systems are incredibly flexible, allowing us to seamlessly adapt each component to your specific demands.

Whatever your needs, our skilled service technicians can recommend personalized solutions that fit within your budget. Planning a new home addition or garage conversion? A mini-split is a fantastic way to add climate control without altering your existing HVAC system. Do you wish you could set different temperatures for specific areas of your home? Multi-zone ductless systems offer individual controls for each air handler, making them ideal for HVAC zoning.
